# One command per line; pushing a change to this file runs them on Modal via GitHub Actions.
# run 16a: stage 1b ONLY (--dress-only, no stage 2) on the four run 15 products that were wrong plus azure as a control,
# export 0.6.0 with the P0 / D15 ease fix (blouse, skirt and cardigan proxies changed by 1-2 cm, so their job ids differ
# from run 15), control proxy 0.3.0, prompt 0.3.0, stage 1b QA 0.9.0 (thresholds provisional): composites from the
# mannequin colour model (no background, the region outside the proxy only when it is cloth), cleaned shop masks, the
# trouser gap strip, hips of skirts, dresses and trousers conformed to the proxy, print edge ratio >= 0.5, and the type
# checks (see-through, body too short, front/back of different garments, legs merged, narrow at the hips, drawn but not pasted).
# Blouse, cardigan and palazzo run both engines (FASHN + Qwen; pick_engine prefers a candidate without a type failure);
# skirt and azure run FASHN only (skirt: checks the hip conform on GPU; azure: a dress that passed must still pass).
# Cost estimate (GPU list price, not the invoice): about $0.21-0.25 per product with both engines (run 13: 189 GPU s,
# $0.21), about $0.03-0.07 for FASHN only: about $0.70-0.90 in all, at most about $1.05. No stage 2 is run.
# Order: every export (no GPU) runs before the first GPU command, so a non-GPU failure stops the run before any spend.
# Each modal line ends in `|| echo ::warning::`: a product that fails does not skip the products after it. Read each
# product's stage1b/record.json (qa, type_failures, unpasted, conform with headroom, selection) and the stills before 16b.
pnpm build:packages
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike shop:bohohippychic -- --fetch-images
git diff --exit-code -- spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/images.json spikes/garment-engine/data/bohohippychic/products.json
# top: blouse with half-sleeve shells; run 15's torn stills came from our composite (the cream ground is the proxy's beige); FASHN's back print is washed out (edge ratio 0.40)
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product rosewater-blouse
# trousers: wide-leg palazzo; the shop photo's legs read as one skirt; gap strip kept open and visible to FASHN, Qwen told "two separate trouser legs"
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product rosewater-palazzo-pants
# skirt: maxi; run 15's FASHN skirt was narrower than our hips (grey hips beside it, side slit in the video); hips now conformed to the proxy
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt
# outerwear: knit cardigan; run 15 front a cropped bolero (cause not fixed), back grey sleeves from holes in the shop mask (fixed)
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi
# control: azure dress (passed in runs 14 and 15); the conform and the new composite must leave it passing
pnpm --filter @curtain/garment-spike export:phase0 -- --shop bohohippychic --product azure-palm-baby-doll-dress
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/rosewater-blouse --dress --dress-engine both --dress-only --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::rosewater-blouse: stage 1b failed"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/rosewater-palazzo-pants --dress --dress-engine both --dress-only --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::rosewater-palazzo-pants: stage 1b failed"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt --dress --dress-engine fashn --dress-only --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::crimson-wildflower-maxi-skirt: stage 1b failed"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi --dress --dress-engine both --dress-only --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::woodstock-wanderer-knit-cardi: stage 1b failed"
modal run spikes/garment-engine/modal/run_phase0.py --job-dir spikes/garment-engine/out/phase0/azure-palm-baby-doll-dress --dress --dress-engine fashn --dress-only --no-synthetic-recon || echo "::warning::azure-palm-baby-doll-dress: stage 1b failed"
# Then run 16b (separate push): only products whose 16a stills have no type failure and pass, or whose only failures
# are the provisional ones the founder accepts, end to end with the run 15 line (--dress --dress-engine <picked engine>
# --accept-failed-dress --no-synthetic-recon), about $1.65-1.71 each; the skirt first (the slit fix in stage 2 is inferred).
